topic: How Small Businesses Can Setup AI Voice Receptionists

avatar_dialogue.clean_text: Every missed call is a customer you just handed to a competitor. Small businesses lose thousands each month to unanswered phones. Today I'll show you how to set up an AI voice receptionist. It answers every call, books appointments, and never takes a break. First, pick a platform that handles inbound calls with a natural voice. You describe your business once, and it learns your hours and services. Step one, connect your existing business phone number. Step two, write a short greeting the AI will speak to callers. Step three, tell it how to book, transfer, or take a message. The AI greets the caller, answers common questions, and captures details. It can even send you a text summary the moment a call ends. A human receptionist can cost thousands of dollars each month. An AI agent often runs for the price of a dinner out. Set this up once, and your phone is covered around the clock. That means more booked jobs and zero missed opportunities. If this saved you a headache, subscribe for more small business AI wins. Drop a comment with the tool you want me to test next.
